provided_uploaded_source_analysis_contex.content:
API v1 remains available until 30 June 2026. V2 changes authentication headers, pagination tokens, and error envelopes. Clients should first add dual parsing, then switch test traffic, verify idempotency, and finally migrate production traffic. Rollback means returning traffic to v1 while preserving v2 logs. Bulk-export endpoints and XML responses are not supported in v2. The guide does not provide throughput benchmarks or a mandatory migration duration.
